            groups[prefix].append(name)

    # Function to calculate the number of ways to arrange a group of names
    def arrange_group(group):
        if not group:
            return 1
        group.sort()
        count = factorial(len(group)) % MOD
        last = group[0]
        consecutive_count = 1
        for name in group[1:]:
            if name == last:
                consecutive_count += 1
            else:
                count *= factorial(consecutive_count) % MOD
                count %= MOD
                last = name
                consecutive_count = 1
        count *= factorial(consecutive_count) % MOD
        count %= MOD
        return count

    # Calculate the total number of valid orderings
    total_orderings = 1
    for group in prefix_groups.values():
        total_orderings *= arrange_group(group)
        total_orderings %= MOD

    return total_orderings

    # Calculate the number of ways to interleave these groups
    def multinomial_coefficient(n, *ks):
        numerator = factorial(n)
        denominator = 1
        for k in ks:
            denominator *= factorial(k)
        return numerator // denominator % MOD
    
    # Sort groups by their length of prefix

    ks = [len(group) for group in sorted_groups]
    total_ways = total_ways * multinomial_coefficient(total_length, *ks) % MOD

    for name in names:

        for char in name:

    # Start DFS from the root of the tree
    return dfs(tree)
